column1: # Group-lasso lambda CALIBRATION (appendix J.3 step 1) — 12-epoch pilots, seed 2501
# Registered as calibration, NOT a result: these numbers select the sweep ladder
# and nothing else is concluded from them.
# live_l0_rows = layer-1 input rows that are NOT exactly zero in the produced bake
# Reference: the same recipe at lambda=0 and FULL 120 epochs (K944_s2501) = 667 live.
# The 667 baseline is the number to subtract from: 277 of the 944 columns are
# constant and the recipe zeroes them on its own (see live_input_structure meta).
# LADDER SELECTED for the registered sweep: lambda in {0.3, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0} x
# seeds {2501, 2503}. 0.3 is the "few dropped" end (0 varying inputs killed at
# 12 epochs), 4.0 the aggressive end (465 of 667 killed), 16.0 is past collapse
# (every row zero, best_val 0.0) and is excluded.
# Note on step count: the proximal threshold is lr*lambda per step and Adam's
# update magnitude is ~lr per step regardless of gradient size, so the survival
# balance is lambda vs 1 PER STEP — more epochs give more time to REACH the
# equilibrium, they do not move it. 12 epochs = 600k steps is already deep into
# that regime, which is why a 1/10-length pilot is informative here. Whether the
# full-length live counts match the pilot's is reported as measured.
